title: Lesson 099 · CISC and RISC: Instruction Set Design
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: CISC typically offers a larger/more complex instruction repertoire, with instructions able to combine operations; RISC generally uses more regular, often simple operations.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: RISC load/store designs explicitly move operands between memory and registers and perform ALU work using registers.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Avoid outdated absolutes: modern CISC and RISC microarchitectures can both pipeline, use caches and achieve strong performance; trade-offs depend on implementation.

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the reasoning
blocks.text: LOAD R1,A→5; LOAD R2,B→8; ADD R3,R1,R2→13; STORE C,R3→13.
